prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE polished transparent 2D action-RPG overhead character title ornament for a helpful raid carry driver, Korean community game role "버스기사" (bus driver).
Create a beautiful original fantasy-game title reward insignia, wide horizontal with a 3.4:1 overall silhouette, centered in a wide landscape canvas, generous transparent padding. This is an ornament frame for separate crisp Korean lettering later, so absolutely NO lettering in this image.
At the top center, a small charming yet premium cream-and-celadon touring bus viewed from a slight front 3/4 angle, modeled as a beautiful enamel guild insignia. The tiny bus has readable windshield and two warm headlamps, restrained brass trim. A refined brass steering-wheel halo sits behind the bus. Symmetrical sweeping ivory feathered wings and clean gold laurel details spread out to either side, giving an official, dependable, welcoming chauffeur-guild award feeling. A few mint-blue magical motes and subtle warm-gold sparkle around the extremities.
Leave a LARGE, clean, uninterrupted dark deep-teal central area in the LOWER TWO-THIRDS of the ornament for the main four-character Korean title to be drawn by the application. The bus and halo sit ABOVE that text area and do not overlap it. Include a tiny blank narrow green ribbon immediately above the large blank central name area, available for a small subtitle. Gold edge work is refined and airy, not an oversized solid rectangular plaque. Do not put any fake symbols, lines, placeholders, markings or text in the text areas.
Visual tone: stylish high-end hand-painted 2D Korean fantasy action-RPG title badge, readable at 320 pixels wide. Elegant and slightly playful, NOT sinister, not a children's sticker, no demon crown, no skulls, no character portrait, no reward coins or currencies. Satin champagne gold, ivory, celadon/mint enamel and deep midnight teal. Natural crafted metal shading, restrained highlights, NO blown-out chrome glare.
All wing tips and particles must be comfortably inside the image. True transparent alpha background outside the ornament, no backdrop, no checkerboard texture. Exactly one standalone ornament. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logo, NO watermark, NO presentation sheet, NO mockup.
lettering: Separate Canvas 2D text layer, Black Han Sans OFL. Original generated pixels preserved.
